## Summary

Adds a reusable `SetBatcherAndSigner` template for atomically updating
`batcherHash` and `unsafeBlockSigner` on `SystemConfig` in a single batched
Multicall3 tx from `FoundationUpgradeSafe`. Mirrors the `SystemConfigGasParams`
pattern — same safe, same target, same storage-write surface.

### Files

- `src/template/SetBatcherAndSigner.sol` — template with inline `ISystemConfig`
- `test/tasks/example/sep/035-set-batcher-and-signer/` — example task for OP Sepolia
- `test/tasks/Regression.t.sol` — pinned-calldata regression test

## Test plan

- [x] `forge build --deny-warnings` / `forge fmt --check` / `check-struct-order.sh` clean
- [x] `forge test --match-test SetBatcherAndSigner` — 1/1 passed
- [x] Example task simulated end-to-end; diff shows only the two expected
      `SystemConfig` slots + safe nonce bump

topPRs.title: chore: restore 074 to EXECUTED, split new rotation into 075
topPRs.author: Ethnical
topPRs.body: ## Summary `074-deputy-pause-key-rotation` was reset to `READY TO SIGN` in #1402 to redo the DPM rotation via `FoundationUpgradeSafe` against the new DPM. That reset overwrote the authentic on-chain execution record of the original rotation ([tx `0xb5f1725e…`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0xb5f1725e6f29081ca47e25d97e4f572e4e82dfde9678a4b9d5e45139876af8c7) on 2026-04-17, signed by `FoundationOperationsSafe` against the old DPM `0xc6f7C07…`, succeeded). I've simulated the whole pause in the fork after this execution: This PR splits the two: - **`src/tasks/sep/074-deputy-pause-key-rotation/`** — restored to the exact pre-#1402 `EXECUTED` state. Preserves the historical record of what actually landed. - **`src/tasks/sep/075-deputy-pause-key-rotation/`** — new task holding the #1402 rotation content: `FoundationUpgradeSafe`, new DPM `0xC10dAc07…`, nonce override 69. Status `READY TO SIGN`. ## Fixes inherited from #1402 The post-#1402 content had several internal inconsistencies. Applied while copying into 075: 1. **config.toml `stateOverrides`** target was `0x837DE4…` (FoundationOperationsSafe) — the override never actually pinned `FoundationUpgradeSafe`'s nonce. Moved to `0xDEe57160…` so the override works as intended. 2. **VALIDATION.md State Overrides section** — the Etherscan link pointed at `0x837DE4…` while the header named `0xDEe57160…`. Fixed. 3. **VALIDATION.md nonce-change "Detail" line** was a wrong copy-paste from the deputy change section. Replaced with the correct description. 4. **README.md Objective / Execution / Signing sections** still named the old safe and old DPM. Updated to `FoundationUpgradeSafe` + new DPM. ## Regenerated message hash With the `stateOverride` fix, the nonce=69 pin now actually applies to `FoundationUpgradeSafe`. The VALIDATION.md message hash from #1402 (`0xe237ee9c…`) was only stable while the broken override was silently ignored and `FoundationUpgradeSafe`'s live nonce drifted. New stable hash computed under the fixed config: ``` Domain Hash: 0x37e1f5dd3b92a004a23589b741196c8a214629d4ea3a690ec8e41ae45c689cbb Message Hash: 0x6f8c38c0b276d934e3eee0ce8638805238502f393b543a6ee7d523c25b888d98 ``` ## Test plan - [x] `bash src/script/check-task-statuses.sh` passes locally - [x] `just simulate` on 075 reproduces the Domain + Message hashes above against `FoundationUpgradeSafe` with nonce=69 pinned - [x] `just simulate` on 074 — not applicable; 074 is now `EXECUTED`, `fetch-tasks.sh` skips it 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
